name: The Will of Marcos
description: His last will. At its reading each friend receives the same letter and annotated map.

name: Marcos's Letter
description: Great treasure waits at the Temple of St. Rylan, deep in the Forest of Dawn: the Seven Silver Spheres, long thought lost, whose existence he has proved. He has researched the paths too, but is too old to walk them safely.

name: Marcos's Annotated Map
description:
The player handout. Its notes:

- "Begin here" at the fork of the old road and the forest trail.
- The well was a secret escape route.
- The temple door opens only on the Spring or Autumn equinox; be quick, and don't linger among the trees.
- There was once a village at the bridge, but he knows of no human settlers still living there.
- Do not stray from the old road or the trails: the forest is full of shadows, and imperial authority left long ago.

name: Archmage Hann's Note
description: Left on the empty pedestals: the two missing spheres will be returned as soon as his "very important work" is complete.

name: The Last Priest's Plea
description: Carved in old-fashioned script beside the altar: a welcome to travellers, and a plea not to disturb the ritual or the spheres, which are all that keeps the forest's shadow from spreading. The more that is taken, the weaker the magic.

name: The Teachings of Goblob
description: Scrawled teachings of Goblob, The Best Goblin; copies turn up as minor loot.
